title: Home Claim Failure Rate
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=claim:home
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(claim_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by claim_type
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often home insurance claim records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each claim type.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize claim_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per claim type.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your home insurance claim data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
